kyoto_minatoya_kosodate_ame.gf_detail: Ask. One hard candy made from malt syrup and sugar; one reviewer read the label as malt sugar from sweet potato and corn, but no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_minatoya_kosodate_ame.vegan_detail: Ask. A candy of malt syrup and granulated sugar, and loose Uji tea; ingredients beyond that are not published (reviews; official site).
kyoto_minatoya_kosodate_ame.hours_raw: 10:00–16:00, every day of the year; open later during Rokudo Mairi (Tabelog); may close for sudden events (official site, January 2026). Takeaway only — a small counter shop with no seating. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). The small 75 g bag often sells out early; ask the shop to hold one (official site). On Matsubara-dori east of Yamato-oji, at Rokudo no Tsuji, 2 min walk from Rokuharamitsu-ji, 10 min from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (official site).
kyoto_minatoya_kosodate_ame.notes: [Candy shop · Rokuhara, by Rokuharamitsu-ji] A tiny shop that sells one thing: amber malt-syrup candy, broken by hand, tied to a 1599 legend of a dead mother whose ghost came nightly to buy candy for the baby born in the grave. The shop calls itself Japan's oldest candy maker, over 450 years old. A bag is ¥700 (¥400 small), with Uji teas beside it — a gentle sweetness and a story to take home. Open daily 10:00–16:00; cash only.

roles: Family shop, people not named (official site signs as みなとや一同)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Japan’s longest-established candy shop, over 450 years old; the legend: in Keicho 4 (1599) a wife of the 江村 family was buried, and days later a baby’s cry was heard from the grave — the child of the dead wife; a woman had come every night to buy candy and stopped once the child was dug out; the child became a monk at eight and a renowned priest, dying at 68 in 1666; the candy came to be called the ghost’s child-rearing candy. The shop has supplied its candy to はぐくみハッピーギフト, a Higashiyama ward gift for new parents, and received a letter of thanks (official site, March 2021). Candy and tea are made by hand (official site, September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to keep passing on the story of “the candy that carried a life”.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 first-timer was told by the staff that the ghost first came 426 years ago.
A December 2025 regular notes the legend is said to have inspired GeGeGe no Kitaro.
A September 2025 visitor bought a bag as a gift for a couple expecting a baby.

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway counter; cash only.

kyoto_shinshindo_kyodai_kitamonmae.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a bakery café — rolls, sandwiches, toast, cream puffs and curry (2025–26 reviews).

kyoto_shinshindo_kyodai_kitamonmae.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 10:00–18:00 (last order 17:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). rurubu also lists 10:00–18:00, closed Tuesday. Order at the counter, then sit (May 2026 review). No bookings; cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). No photos inside: signs on the door and in the room (Tabelog; November 2025–August 2026 reviews). 100 seats at long wooden tables, with tables kept for students and a student discount on coffee with a university ID (November 2025 and February 2026 reviews; a May 2026 diner was told the discount needs the whole party to be university students). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Facing Kyoto University's north gate; 10 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_shinshindo_kyodai_kitamonmae.notes: [1930 student café · Kyoto University north gate] Kyoto's "second university library": a Paris-inspired café opened in 1930, with massive wooden tables by the craftsman Kuroda Tatsuaki, a courtyard, and students reading over a single blend coffee, curry or a sandwich. About ¥1,000. Cash only; no photos inside; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in 1930 as a French-style café by the bakery 進々堂, which began in 1913 and was the first in Kyoto to sell French bread; the founder, 続木斉, had studied bread-making in Paris and modelled the café on those in the Latin Quarter, hoping Japanese students would also learn Western esprit (serai.jp). The long one-piece tables and benches were commissioned from the woodworker 黒田辰秋 so many students could sit at once (serai.jp; rurubu; November 2025 review). The fourth-generation proprietor 川口聡 says the café's atmosphere stays the same because of the founding ideals (serai.jp, undated). Operator: rurubu says the café is now a separate corporation from the 進々堂 bakery, and the bakery's own shop list does not include it; 2026 reviewers still call it a branch of the Kyoto bakery chain (May and September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: "The air of the shop stays the same even as the times and the town change, because of the founding ideals" (川口聡, serai.jp).
chef_bio.specialty: Blend coffee; curry rice set; sandwiches.

anecdotes.text: In October 2025 a visitor returned after about 50 years, reading a maths and physics book bought at a nearby bookshop over black coffee.
A November 2025 visitor on the way to Ginkaku-ji found the sandwiches sold out, took the roll-bread brunch set, and found the staff's indifference very Kyoto.
A November 2025 visitor was told that lingering was not allowed before noon, and felt the many notices spoiled the calm.

kyoto_hatoya_shokudo.notes: [Diner · Higashioji Marutamachi, home cooking from 6 am] A long-running diner facing Kumano Shrine, open from dawn: order a pork miso soup, sake-lees soup or udon, then pick a couple of home-style sides — grilled mackerel, chilled tofu, rolled egg — from the trays, for under ¥1,000. Cash only; no children; closed Saturday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who serves from the side-dish trays (February 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a cafeteria-style diner at the Higashioji Marutamachi crossing. A December 2025 reviewer read online that it has been in business for over 70 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Pork miso soup set; pick-your-own sides.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 morning jogger stopped for a kitsune udon set with simmered mackerel, ¥900 in all.
A November 2025 visitor hunting for an early-opening breakfast found it and parked behind Kumano Shrine.
An October 2026 visitor noted how hard it is to find ordinary home cooking out, and why regulars might come daily.

kyoto_nagamegawa_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki with tempura, sukiyaki, saikyo-miso fish and yudofu (2026 reviews); no gluten information.

kyoto_nagamegawa_pontocho.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order 20:30), daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; guests with preschool children are seated only in private rooms, if one is free (Tabelog). The kawadoko (river terrace) moves indoors if rain is likely, and wet terrace or kotatsu-terrace seats move indoors (Tabelog); terrace seating ran to the end of October in 2026 (October 2026). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料10％」). Cards incl. UnionPay; QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 60 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). The eighth house on the east side of Pontocho north of Shijo; 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). No children’s menu (September 2026).
kyoto_nagamegawa_pontocho.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Pontocho, kaiseki on the river terrace] A Pontocho house with a kawadoko over the Kamo River that stays open to the end of October: a ¥4,840 mini kaiseki with Omi beef sukiyaki at lunch, summer kaiseki (¥6,600) with yuba, hamo and yudofu, or indoor seats with a river view. 10% service. Preschool children only in private rooms; no kids menu.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Japanese, tofu and sukiyaki restaurant on Pontocho with river-terrace and kotatsu-terrace seating.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner was glad the terrace was still open at month’s end, when neighbours had closed theirs by mid-October.
An October 2026 overseas visitor was glad a first taste of Kyoto cuisine came here, and the friends all loved it.
A September 2026 parent noted there is no children’s menu, calling the terrace kaiseki a place for adults.

kyoto_tairiki_tei_nanzenji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat udon and tempura (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_tairiki_tei_nanzenji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: udon in dashi with chicken and burdock tempura (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tairiki_tei_nanzenji.hours_raw: 11:30–20:00, open all year (Tabelog). Dinner reservations are for courses only (official site); at lunch, expect a queue from before opening with numbered tickets (October–November 2026). Cancellation on the day costs 100%, and switching from a course to à la carte after arriving is charged at the course price (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 47 seats: counters facing the garden, tables, private room (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking; smoking area outside (Tabelog). 1 min from the main gate of Nanzen-ji; 9 min from Keage Stn (Tabelog). First anniversary celebrated in January 2025 (official site).
kyoto_tairiki_tei_nanzenji.notes: [Udon and café · Nanzen-ji, a garden view with lunch] A restaurant a minute from Nanzen-ji’s gate whose counters look out on a Japanese garden: homemade udon with Awa-chicken or burdock tempura (¥1,600–1,700), dango you toast yourself and matcha latte. Very popular — a numbered queue forms before 11:30. Dinner is courses only, by reservation. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a restaurant with a seasonal Japanese garden view and homemade udon, which marked its first anniversary in January 2025 with maiko dances; dinner reservations are for courses only. An October 2026 reviewer says the garden was designed by an 11th-generation gardener of the Ogawa line.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor arrived at 11:00 and saw a queue form quickly; only courses could be booked.
A September 2026 café visitor enjoyed toasting dango at the table with a choice of toppings.
A November 2026 visitor arriving five minutes before opening was the 15th group in line.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 四季折々の絶景の庭園、職人の自家製うどん、ディナーの予約はコースのみ、2025年1月に開店1周年の舞妓の舞。食べログ: うどん・ステーキ・カフェ、左京区南禅寺草川町81、南禅寺の正門から徒歩1分、蹴上駅から徒歩9分、11:30〜20:00、無休、予約可 (当日キャンセル100%、来店後のコースからの変更もコース料金)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、47席、禁煙 (外に喫煙所)。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): Awa の鶏と舞茸の天ぷらうどん1,700円、大きなごぼう天うどん1,600円、自分で焼く団子、抹茶ラテ、庭に面したカウンター、開店前から整理券の行列。

cultural_comfort.note: Queue for a numbered ticket at lunch; dinner is courses by reservation. Many overseas visitors (November 2026). No English evidence found.

kyoto_takoyaki_kohaku_takano.gf_detail: Not GF: takoyaki in a batter of domestic wheat (2025 reviews).
kyoto_takoyaki_kohaku_takano.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus takoyaki in a dashi batter, topped with bonito flakes (2024–2025 reviews).
kyoto_takoyaki_kohaku_takano.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 12:00–20:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, JCB), iD and QR incl. PayPay (Tabelog). 4 standing places at the counter; takeaway; non-smoking (Tabelog). Order inside, past a plastic curtain (November 2025). At the corner of Kitaoji and Higashioji by the Takano bus stop; about 6 min walk from Chayama Stn (Tabelog; November 2025). Sometimes runs a kitchen car at events (May 2025).
kyoto_takoyaki_kohaku_takano.notes: [Takoyaki · Takano, by Kitaoji-Higashioji] A stylish little stand making additive-free takoyaki with domestic wheat and a dashi-rich batter — fluffy and creamy, with big pieces of octopus — in flavours from classic sauce and Kyoto sesame to negi-dashi soy, salsa and pesto. Order as few as three. One August 2026 visitor found the balls seemingly pre-cooked, with a hard skin. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a takoyaki shop at Takano with a website at takoyaki-kohaku.com; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers describe an owner who chooses ingredients carefully, additive-free takoyaki of domestic wheat (2024–2025), and a kitchen car at an organic market event (May 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Additive-free, carefully chosen ingredients (2024–2025 reviews).

anecdotes.text: In May 2025 the shop ran a kitchen car at an organic-store anniversary event, with about fifteen people queuing.
A July 2024 fan called it the best takoyaki ever and pleaded for a Tokyo branch.
An August 2026 visitor ordering salt and sesame oil found the balls seemingly pre-cooked, with a hard skin.

kyoto_kiraku_toei_uzumasa.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat ramen and tsukemen, curry ramen, fried chicken (2024–2025 reviews).

kyoto_kiraku_toei_uzumasa.hours_raw: Inside Toei Kyoto Studio Park (Toei Uzumasa Eigamura) — park admission is needed, and re-entry is not allowed (Tabelog; February 2025). 9:00–17:00 from 1 March to 30 November, 9:30–16:00 from 1 December to 28 February; closed 24–31 December; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations for groups only (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 52 seats; non-smoking; parking at the park (Tabelog). 5 min walk from Uzumasa-Koryuji Stn, 13 min from JR Uzumasa Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kiraku_toei_uzumasa.notes: [Ramen · inside Toei Kyoto Studio Park, Uzumasa] A family-friendly ramen canteen inside the Edo-period film-set park — you need a park ticket to eat here, with no re-entry. Curry ramen, Mito Komon-themed ramen with garlic and ginger to stir in, cold tsukemen, kids sets and collaboration specials, at prices lower than the park's other restaurants. One guest found the miso broth watery. Daytime only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a ramen and tsukemen restaurant inside Toei Uzumasa Eigamura, with seasonal hours. Reviewers describe one of several eateries in the park, cheaper than the rest, with collaboration menus tied to park events (2024–2025).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 family, finding other park restaurants priced at ¥1,500–2,000 a set and unable to leave and re-enter, settled here for an ¥800 miso ramen.
A February 2024 Setsubun visitor with family found the curry ramen mild enough for children.
A February 2024 guest found the outside menu display did not match the sets offered inside.

kyoto_m_and_maison_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese breakfast sets of grilled fish, small vegetable dishes, tamagoyaki, sesame tofu, miso soup and rice; side dishes are not explained in detail (2026 reviews).
kyoto_m_and_maison_gojo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sets centre on grilled or raw fish, tamagoyaki and dashi-based miso soup (2026 reviews).
kyoto_m_and_maison_gojo.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 8:00–15:00; Saturday–Sunday 7:30–15:00; last order 14:30; irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, online; advised for holiday mornings (Tabelog; September 2026). English menu (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 22 seats: 6 at the counter and one table on the 1F, three tables on the 2F; non-smoking; coin parking next door (Tabelog). A tiled roof and a wooden sign with a fish mark on Rokujo-dori; 5 min walk from Gojo Stn, 10 from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_m_and_maison_gojo.notes: [Japanese breakfast · Rokujo by Gojo Stn] A tiled-roof restaurant near Kyoto Station serving a ryokan-style Japanese breakfast from 7:30 at weekends: grilled fish with miso soup and three or five seasonal small dishes, and a praised corn rice. A reviewer calls it the New York eatery OKONOMI brought back to Kyoto; English menu. Some find it a little pricey or average; one found the miso soup lukewarm. Book for holidays.

roles: Kitchen at the open counter and floor staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a breakfast set restaurant to experience the seasons of Kyoto; registered as an official listing by the operator. A November 2026 reviewer says it was born from bringing the New York Japanese eatery OKONOMI back to Kyoto; July 2026 reviewers note its popularity for breakfast.
chef_bio.philosophy: Experience the seasons of Kyoto at breakfast (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 guest wished the grilled corn rice were sold as onigiri, and likened the meal to a ryokan breakfast.
A September 2026 couple found the service attentive but the first miso soup lukewarm.
An October 2026 diner thought it aimed at inbound tourists, with no explanation of the side dishes and nothing especially Kyoto about it.

kyoto_sushitetsu_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. À la carte nigiri with soy; small cooked dishes such as kinpira and ganmodoki as otoshi; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushitetsu_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi bar; natto and egg are on the nigiri list, but most items are fish and shellfish (2026 reviews).

Reservations only for tatami seating for 4 or more; otherwise write your name on the board and queue — a line of about 30 at 19:00 one September evening; a 60-minute last order (August 2026) or a 90-minute limit (October 2026). kyoto_sushitetsu_pontocho.notes: [Sushi · Pontocho on the Kamo River, queue and eat] A busy, cheerful sushi bar by the river where most nigiri — chutoro included — cost about ¥280 for two, plus wagyu sushi and fresh akagai; most reviewers spent ¥3,000–3,999. No bookings except tatami for four or more: write your name and wait, with time limits when busy. Table service can lag behind the counter. ¥324 seat fee. Open till midnight.

roles: Sushi chefs at the counter and floor staff (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a sushi bar in the Karafuneya Pontocho building, with hours that change with supply. Reviewers in 2026 describe long queues, a mix of Japanese and overseas guests, a pleasant chef, and prices only a little above conveyor-belt sushi.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner noted that chutoro costs the same as natto and joked that this was unfair to the natto.
A September 2026 repeat visitor arrived 30 minutes before opening and was the seventh group in line.
At 19:00 in September 2026 there was a line of about thirty, half Japanese and half overseas visitors.

kyoto_minari_isetan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: chijimi, cold noodles, japchae and gochujang- and soy-based sauces in the sets (2026 reviews).

Busy at weekend lunch — check the wait by QR code (May 2026). 45 seats (41 at tables, 4 on sofas), semi-private seating; non-smoking; wheelchair access; children welcome. Cards accepted; e-money only Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog).
kyoto_minari_isetan.notes: [Korean · Kyoto Station Isetan 11F, vegetable-heavy set meals] A calm Korean home-cooking room on JR Kyoto Isetan's restaurant floor: bibimbap, sundubu, samgyetang and bossam in sets of kimchi and little side dishes, mildly spiced and full of vegetables — easy off the train or with children. Diners found the set chijimi small or cold (June, September 2026) and the bossam pork tough (October 2026).

chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a spacious, semi-private room on the department store's restaurant floor, sweeter, mild seasoning that suited children, solo women and small groups, and fewer tourists than other Kyoto Station spots (June 2026). A 美菜莉 also runs on Ginza Mitsukoshi's 11th floor (LINE notice); an August 2026 diner mentions a popular Tokyo branch.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "the pork was tougher than I expected, making it a bit difficult to chew… Also, the vegetables were unseasoned, so a little dipping sauce would have been appreciated."
June 2026: "I was surprised by the small size of the chijimi in the set."
June 2026: "overall, the flavors were on the sweeter side, which was comforting since we had elementary school kids with us."

kyoto_nijo_en.notes: [Tempura and oden · Nijo Station, a dashi-proud izakaya] A cosy two-floor izakaya by Nijo Station: a ten-kind tempura platter, oden in the house dashi, Kyoto vegetables with white miso, and a good list of less-common sake, with the owner chatting across the counter. Some found portions small and prices high (June, August 2026), and late in the evening much sells out. No service charge. Closed Thursday.

roles: Owner, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Opened 9 April 2019 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2023 to 2026 describe a cosy room where solo diners chat with the owner across the counter, staff who say "we pride ourselves on our dashi" (January 2024), attentive service, and an upstairs room used by families and groups.

anecdotes.text: January 2024: on the staff's recommendation — "We pride ourselves on our dashi" — the family chose oden.

kyoto_ching_ming_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Cantonese-leaning meat and seafood dishes and set meals (2026 reviews).

Non-smoking (including heated tobacco). English menu; children welcome. Cards, transit IC and e-money, QR. 5th floor of the Yasaka Gion Building beside Yojiya; the entrance is behind a coffee shop (October 2026); window views over Hanamikoji.
kyoto_ching_ming_gion.notes: [Chinese · Gion, a 5th-floor view over Hanamikoji] The Kyoto branch of Osaka's 1967 Chinese house Ching-Ming, five floors above the Gion crossing with windows over Hanamikoji: a good-value ¥1,600 lunch gozen, eight-treasure yakisoba and shark-fin ramen at night. Regulars note shrinking portions (July–August 2026); some found the pre-made side dishes just okay (August 2026) and the room too cold. 10% service charge after 17:00.

roles: Not named in a source; branch of 青冥 (Ching-Ming)
chef_bio.background: 青冥 was founded in 1967 with its main shop in Dojima, Osaka (Ikyu listing); a 2026 recruiting page for 株式会社ミヨシコーポレーション lists 青冥 堂島本店, 祇園店, 阪急池田店 and 大丸梅田店. anecdotes.text: September 2026: "My late father often took me to the Chinmin in Umeda… He always ordered the Eight Treasure Yakisoba. This Kyoto branch was also incredibly delicious."
July 2026, a regular: "it seems like the portion sizes have decreased compared to before."
August 2026: "The freshly made sweet and sour pork was delicious, but the pre-made mapo tofu and stir-fried noodles with sauce were just okay."

kyoto_kroon_demachiyanagi.hours_raw: Tabelog lists no hours. Reviewers ate lunch sets (four choices) on weekdays and weekends at about 13:00, and dinner late in the evening (2024–2026). kyoto_kroon_demachiyanagi.notes: [Thai · Demachiyanagi, student-friendly lunch sets] A cosy 16-seat Thai restaurant on a lane by Demachiyanagi Station since 2008: pad Thai, green curry and kra pao rice lunch sets with fresh spring rolls, and spicy clams and shrimp skewers in the evening. One diner found the pad Thai too sweet and felt pushed to order drinks (January 2025). Cash only; smoking allowed per Tabelog.

chef_bio.background: Opened 28 June 2008 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe a counter and a few tables, a kitchen and a single front-of-house server, a warm welcome, and a spillover crowd from the omurice shop next door. Its former website address now opens the site of イーサン, a Thai restaurant at Imadegawa (fetched 6 November 2026).

anecdotes.text: January 2025: "The female staff member was energetic, but her demeanor felt a bit unfriendly, almost pressuring me to order drinks… the seasoning was on the sweeter side."
"Upon opening the door, I was transported to Thailand." — January 2025.

kyoto_lush_life_demachiyanagi.notes: [Jazz kissa · Demachiyanagi, coffee and records by the station] A nine-seat counter coffee-and-jazz shop under a striped awning at Demachiyanagi Station, lined with LPs: coffee, a firm old-fashioned pudding, curry and hayashi rice, and a drink on the terrace. anecdotes.text: February 2025: "Even though it's a jazz café, the atmosphere is relaxed enough for casual conversations… On the day I visited, I could see heavy snowfall through the window."
July 2026: "only nine counter seats (non-smoking, while the outdoor terrace is smoking-friendly). The walls are lined with LP records. The menu is a charming wooden dice shape."

kyoto_thai_esan_imadegawa.gf_detail: Ask: rice dishes such as khao man gai and many curries may be wheat-free, but soy and oyster sauces, fried dishes and wheat-noodle dishes are on the 100-plus menu (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_thai_esan_imadegawa.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options among the 100-plus dishes; fish sauce is otherwise standard (Tabelog).
kyoto_thai_esan_imadegawa.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:00–14:30 (last entry 14:20) and 17:00–22:00 (last entry 21:50); closed Tuesday and at New Year. Weekday and weekend lunch buffet ¥1,600 (Tabelog) — ¥1,650 incl. tax on 7 November 2026 (official site), with an extra free dish per person on weekends and holidays (October 2026); buffet seats may be limited to an hour when busy. kyoto_thai_esan_imadegawa.notes: [Thai · Imadegawa, the Isan lunch buffet by Doshisha] A long-established Isan-style Thai restaurant a minute from Imadegawa Station: a ¥1,650 lunch buffet that fills up, more than 100 dishes marked by heat, vegan options, and a tatami annex in a townhouse for groups. Some found the buffet variety limited and slow to refill (March 2026) and the serving area cramped (October 2026); the som tam can hit hard (April 2026). Closed Tuesday.

roles: Thai chef, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 call it a long-established, "pioneering" Thai restaurant in Kyoto, run by a Thai chef, with Thai-language dish names and spice levels marked on the menu, popular with students from nearby universities and repeat locals. The official site offers a townhouse annex like a ryokan room, and take-away of over 100 dishes. The domain of the Demachiyanagi Thai restaurant Kroon now serves this site (fetched 6 November 2026).

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "The lunch was served buffet-style, and while the taste was decent, the variety was a bit limited. The replenishment of dishes was somewhat slow."
April 2026: "be cautious with the spice level! The green papaya salad… towards the end, it became particularly spicy and salty."
August 2026: with the buffet full, "I was kindly guided to the traditional house next door for a la carte orders."

kyoto_champon_matsuo_kitashirakawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat champon noodles and fried sara-udon noodles (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_champon_matsuo_kitashirakawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kombu-based broth with fish paste, a little pork and seafood (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_champon_matsuo_kitashirakawa.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–20:30; closed Saturday. Reservations taken (Tabelog). 20 seats — two tables for eight and more (March 2024). Non-smoking. kyoto_champon_matsuo_kitashirakawa.notes: [Champon · Kitashirakawa, a vegetable-piled Showa noodle shop] A Showa-era shop at the Kitashirakawa bus stop serving just two things — champon and sara udon — buried under wok-fried cabbage and vegetables in a light, kombu-tasting salt sauce, for ¥800 regular. Some found it bland and added vinegar and mustard (February 2025); another found the sara udon a touch salty (February 2024). Cash only; closed Saturday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2023 to 2026 describe a nostalgic Showa-era interior that has not changed in decades, a menu that is still mainly champon and sara udon, lines in the past and quieter lunches now, and a shop that closed for a time and reopened (April 2026).

kyoto_mama_saikan_rikka.notes: [Chinese and Taiwanese · Hyakumanben, open until 23:30] A two-storey townhouse restaurant by Kyoto University, cooking everyday Northeast Chinese and Taiwanese dishes — gyoza with lemon salt, wonton noodles, yurinchi, pai gu — as cheap lunch sets with brown rice, and staying open until 23:30 for drinks and banquets. kyoto_bistro_cerisier.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday 8:30–14:00 and 18:00–21:30; Thursday 8:30–14:00; Saturday and Sunday 18:00–21:30; hours may change (Tabelog; Michelin Guide). Payment: the shop’s own note on Tabelog says cash only, though Tabelog’s payment field says cards are accepted — bring cash. kyoto_bistro_cerisier.notes: [French bistro · Demachiyanagi, regional classics to share] A small, antique-filled bistro by Demachiyanagi Station, listed in the Michelin Guide, cooking hearty French regional dishes — pâtés, quenelles, cassoulet, choucroute, game — in big portions meant for sharing, with a long regional wine list. Book by phone a month ahead; à la carte at dinner; bring cash.

chef_bio.background: The Michelin Guide says the bistro is the work of a madame captivated by French cuisine who gave shape to a longing for the real thing, in an antique interior with the feel of a country bistro. Reviewers describe a sommelier lady running the dining room (September 2025) and two women serving (December 2025); a regular’s first review dates from February 2011.
chef_bio.specialty: Regional French dishes — quenelles, cassoulet, choucroute.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 party of three booked a holiday dinner a month ahead and found the house full that night.
A July 2026 regular, turned away from the mussels on the previous visit, finally got the mussels.

kyoto_horin_marutamachi.notes: [Ramen · Karasuma-Marutamachi, an old-school town Chinese] A long-standing ramen and Chinese counter on the corner across from Marutamachi Station, run by older cooks who look stern and turn out kind. Smoking allowed; cash only; closed Sunday.

kyoto_gihan_ebisudo_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Xiaolongbao, gyoza and other wheat dim sum, noodles and soy-seasoned stir-fries; congee and fried rice also on the menu; no gluten information is published (reviews).

Cards, e-money, PayPay and Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). 45 seats: a 5-seat counter and spacious tables; children welcome; non-smoking; takeout and delivery (Tabelog). In a century-old townhouse that was once a miso shop, its old miso sign still up, on the Sanjo-kai shopping arcade near TOHO Nijo; 365 m from Nijojo-mae Stn (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gihan_ebisudo_sanjo.notes: [Chinese · Sanjo-kai arcade near Nijo Castle, dim sum in an old miso shop] The casual dim sum house of Kyoto's 一之船入 group, opened in 2010 in a century-old townhouse that still wears a miso shop's sign under red lanterns. Thin-skinned xiaolongbao, crisp pan-fried dumplings, dan dan noodles and seafood congee; weekly lunch sets run about ¥1,200, with dumplings and almond jelly for ¥300 more. Queues at lunch; book for dinner. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner-chef of the 一之船入 group (official site); kitchen staff at Sanjo not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: 魏 禧之 (ぎ・よしゆき) was born in Yokohama and from age 11 worked in the kitchen of the family’s Hunan restaurant in Yokohama Chinatown; trained from 18 at well-known Chinese restaurants across Japan, then in China, qualifying as a special-grade cook; trained at 萬珍楼 in Yokohama Chinatown; opened 創作中華 一之船入 in Kyoto in 1996; bronze at the Taiwan culinary exhibition’s world Chinese cuisine contest (2009); opened 魏飯夷堂 三条店 in 2010 and 魏飯夷堂 北新地 in Osaka in 2013 (closed about four years ago, per an October 2026 reviewer); Kyoto tourism ambassador (2015); China’s highest cook grade (2018); Kyoto Prefecture’s Contemporary Master Craftsman (2020); head of the Kyoto branch of the Japan Chinese Cuisine Association. The group follows 医食同源 (food as medicine) and uses pesticide-free vegetables from contract farms.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: 医食同源 — preventing illness through food, cooking that is delicious and good for the body, shared by all the group’s shops.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor came back after seven years for the xiaolongbao, at ¥200 off in a campaign.
An October 2026 diner, a regular at the Kitashinchi branch before it closed, found the xiaolongbao just as good.
An October 2026 lunch guest was told the vinegared jellyfish had the "highest order count in history".

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ichinohunairi.com): 一之船入グループ (創作中華 一之船入、イチノフナイリ・ザ ショップ、魏飯夷堂 三条店、魏飯吉堂、魏飯餃子)、医食同源、契約農園の無農薬野菜、シェフ 魏 禧之 (ぎ・よしゆき): 横浜市生まれ、11歳から実家の横浜中華街の湖南料理店の厨房に、18歳から全国の有名中華料理店で修業、中国で特級調理士、横浜中華街「萬珍楼」で修行、1996年 京都に「創作中華 一之船入」、2009年 台湾美食展世界中国料理大会銅賞、2010年 飲茶と中華の店「魏飯夷堂 三条店」、2013年「魏飯夷堂 北新地」、2015年 京都国際観光大使、2018年 中国の最高級調理士、2020年 京都府「現代の名工」、日本中国料理協会 京都支部 支部長。三条店: 京都三条会商店街、元・老舗の味噌店の京町家、週替わりのランチセット、火曜定休。食べログ: 中華・居酒屋・バル、中京区三条岩上西入る橋西町661、二条城前駅から365m、昼11:30〜14:30、夜17:30〜22:00 (土日祝は17:00〜)、火曜定休、混雑時は昼1時間・夜1.5時間、カード・電子マネー・QR可、45席 (カウンター5、テーブル40)、禁煙、テイクアウト・デリバリー、2010年9月14日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 小籠包、焼き小籠包、焼き餃子、春巻き、くらげの酢の物、油淋鶏、麻婆豆腐、エビチリ、担々麺、海鮮粥、ごま団子、杏仁豆腐、酢鶏のランチ1,200円、+300円で小籠包2個と杏仁豆腐、飲茶ランチ、味噌屋の看板と赤い提灯、昼は行列。

kyoto_vietnam_french_xuan.notes: [Vietnamese · Kitashirakawa, Vietnamese-French in a canal-side house] A small Vietnamese-French restaurant in a white house by the Shirakawa canal, near the Philosopher's Path: an 11-dish lunch of six pretty starters, a gentle collagen-rich pho and desserts for about ¥2,900, made with Kyoto farm vegetables, and warm hosts who talk about Vietnam. No vegetarian or vegan requests. Book; closed Tuesday and some other days.

roles: Producer: フォン (named on the official site); the chef is not named
chef_bio.origin: Southern Vietnam (the producer's home cooking, per the official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, XUAN began in Tokyo's Nihonbashi in 1997, opened as VIETNAM FRENCH XUAN on Gokomachi in Nakagyo-ku in 2001, and moved to Kitashirakawa in 2014. Its cooking is based on the southern Vietnamese food the producer, フォン, grew up with, using produce from Kyoto farms and fishing ports, Asuka in Nara, and ingredients sourced in Vietnam; it also runs a sweets and ao dai brand, リンホア, and Vietnam tours. Reviewers in 2026 describe a chef and a lady who explain each dish and chat with guests, and the mezzanine sells made-to-order ao dai (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: From the site: using fresh ingredients as they are, cooked in the way of Vietnamese daily life (official site, paraphrased).

anecdotes.text: January 2026: "the hospitality from the chef and the lady was wonderful… We ended up diving into some interesting conversations about hobbies."
April 2026: "I used to visit Xuan several times before it moved, and I had no idea it had relocated to such a lovely house!"

kyoto_nihon_ryori_fujii_ginkakuji.gf_detail: Ask: the shop asks for allergies and dislikes at booking (official site); courses include tempura (sesame-tofu tempura is a signature) and soy- and dashi-based dishes (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nihon_ryori_fujii_ginkakuji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every meal starts from a kombu-and-bonito dashi (official site; January 2025); fish courses such as hamo and sea bream.
kyoto_nihon_ryori_fujii_ginkakuji.hours_raw: Official site: last entry 11:30–13:30 for lunch and 17:00–20:00 for dinner (Tabelog: 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:00); closed Wednesday. Book online or by phone; tell the shop about allergies, dislikes and wishes when booking. Kaiseki at three prices — ¥8,000, ¥15,000 and ¥20,000+ — plus consumption tax and a 10% service charge (official site). Cancellation fees: 30% two days before, 50% the day before, 100% on the day (official site). 18 seats: counter and private rooms (one for 4; up to 20). Non-smoking. Cards (Visa, Master) and QR; no e-money. No parking. A renovated old house a minute from the Philosopher's Path; 7 min walk from Honen-in, 8 min from Ginkaku-ji (official site).
kyoto_nihon_ryori_fujii_ginkakuji.notes: [Kaiseki · Philosopher's Path, dashi first] A calm kaiseki restaurant in a renovated house a minute from the Philosopher's Path, where every meal opens with a cup of dashi: monthly courses from ¥8,000 at lunch, with fried sesame tofu and summer hamo the dishes people remember, at a counter facing the chef or in rooms overlooking maples. Reviewers mention a Michelin star (2024–2025). Plus 10% service; cancellation fees. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site, 藤井 孝之輔 trained at 高台寺 和久傳 and 櫻川, became head chef of 水円 in Gion-Yasaka, and opened 日本料理 藤井 near Ginkaku-ji in February 2018; the hobbies listed are skiing, futsal and driving. The site describes the cooking as "質実、枯淡" — plain and austere — for newcomers to Japanese food and connoisseurs alike. Reviewers from 2023 to 2026 describe a stylishly renovated old house where every table looks onto seasonal plants, a counter facing the chef, careful tableware, and a one-Michelin-star rating (February 2024; January 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: From the site: "日本料理 藤井での食事のはじまりは、出汁から。全ての料理の礎です。" (a meal here begins with dashi — the foundation of every dish).

anecdotes.text: January 2025: "Upon sitting down, I was first served today's dashi (broth), which I believe was made with kombu kelp and katsuo (bonito)."
February 2024: "Points were deducted for not accepting invoices and phone responsiveness, but the taste is undoubtedly exceptional."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 日本料理 藤井、食事のはじまりは出汁から、全ての料理の礎、おしながきはなく月ごとに内容をかえる、苦手なもの・アレルギー・要望は予約時に、質実・枯淡、銀閣寺・哲学の道の近く、左京区浄土寺上南田町九十一、水曜定休、最終入店 11:30〜13:30・17:00〜20:00、会席は8,000円・15,000円・20,000円〜、別途消費税とサービス料10%、キャンセル料 (2日前30%、前日50%、当日100%)、駐車場なし、哲学の道より徒歩1分、店主 藤井 孝之輔は「高台寺 和久傳」「櫻川」などで修行し祇園・八坂「水円」の料理長を経て2018年2月に開店、趣味はスキー・フットサル・ドライブ。食べログ: 日本料理 藤井、18席、個室 (4名、20名まで)、禁煙、カード (VISA・Master)・QR可、電子マネー不可、姉妹店に日本料理 藤井のぷりん (四条寺町)。口コミ (2023年10月〜2026年7月、英語): 最初に昆布と鰹の出汁、胡麻豆腐の天ぷら、鱧、鰻、ホタルイカ、筍、桜鱒、鯛の胡麻だれご飯、お正月の八寸、紅葉の見える個室、ミシュラン一つ星という声、柴漬けの販売、インボイスと電話対応で減点という声。

kyoto_didi_mototanaka.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Wednesday and Thursday (the next day when either is a public holiday). No reservations. 18 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; take-away. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 1 min walk from Eizan Railway Mototanaka Stn.
kyoto_didi_mototanaka.notes: [Curry · Mototanaka, a decades-old neighbourhood curry house] A small curry house a minute from Mototanaka Station on the Eizan line: well-balanced Indian-style chicken, korma and vegetable curries with white or brown rice, a green curry with konjac, and home-made carrot cake and apple crumble. A diner back after 20 years found the taste and staff unchanged (October 2025); another found it just okay (October 2023). Cash only; closed Wednesday and Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2016 to 2025 describe a long-running local curry house with flowers on each table and the same staff over decades; one diner returning after about 20 years found it unchanged (October 2025).

anecdotes.text: October 2025: "I visited after about 20 years… It's spicy, but the heat dissipates quickly… The pleasant spiciness and the familiar atmosphere created by the same staff made me emotional."
September 2022: "The balance of spices is excellent; nothing stands out excessively, yet the spices are aromatic."
October 2023: "It's just okay."

Diners mention waits and hard-to-flag service (March 2023, July 2024) and so-so coffee (November 2023). Cash only; closed Friday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2022 to 2026 describe a renovated Kyoto townhouse with chair and tatami seating, a home-like feel, and a fifteenth anniversary in July 2026. A regular has logged 17 visits since 2015 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: July 2024: "I had to wait quite a while outside the restaurant, and even after entering, I had to wait to place my order and for the food to arrive."
July 2026: the "night lunch" of kara-age, ebi fry and hamburg "felt like an adult version of a kids' meal, which was fun… It seems they are celebrating their 15th anniversary!"
March 2023: "The taste and presentation were good, but the service was lacking. It was hard to get their attention."

kyoto_aozora_thai_curry.gf_detail: Ask. Thai curries with rice — green, red, yellow, peanut — plus khao man gai, karaage and spring rolls; fish sauce is used and no gluten information is given (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_aozora_thai_curry.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the curries carry chicken or shrimp and fish sauce (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_aozora_thai_curry.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Irregular days off are posted on a board out front each month (October 2024). Up a steep stair to the second floor of the K-SIDE building (Tabelog; October 2024). About 7 min on foot from Keihan Demachiyanagi Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_aozora_thai_curry.notes: [Thai curry · near Kyoto University, the peanut curry] A long-running, cosy Thai curry café up a steep staircase near Kyoto University: coconut-rich green, yellow and red curries, a much-loved peanut curry, and khao man gai sets around ¥1,200–1,650 with lassi. Cash only; closed Thursday, with extra days off posted out front.

chef_bio.background: A longtime customer dates the shop to the mid-2000s, about twenty years in business (August 2024); another returned after more than ten years (October 2025).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor who avoids spicy food came for the peanut curry, then returned in May because it was unforgettable.
A July 2026 regular chose Aozora over a sake-brewery stop, reasoning that Thai curry wins in the heat.

kyoto_leucocoryne_jodoji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a croissant bakery; the curry comes with rice or as a doria, but the kitchen is built around wheat pastry and no gluten information is given (official site; reviews).
kyoto_leucocoryne_jodoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: butter croissants, and the curry is made with Omi beef tendon (official site).
kyoto_leucocoryne_jodoji.hours_raw: 8:00–18:00 (December–February L.O. 17:00) (official site); closed Tuesday (Tabelog); hours may change (Tabelog). Breakfast from 8:00 to 10:30 with a croissant of your choice (December 2025). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 13 seats with a counter (Tabelog). One minute on foot from the Jodoji bus stop, near the Philosopher’s Path and Ginkakuji (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_leucocoryne_jodoji.notes: [Croissants and curry · Jodoji, near the Philosopher’s Path] A small bakery-café a minute from the Jodoji bus stop, known for its butter croissants — at breakfast from 8:00 or as ice-cream-and-anko sandwiches — and for a mild Omi-beef-tendon “zushi curry” (¥950). Cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Earlier reviewers describe one young man running the shop alone (November 2022) and an owner who imports goods from places such as Turkey for sale in the shop (January 2023).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 visitor called the croissants alone worth the trip.
A June 2024 hiker came down from Mount Daimon for a matcha croissant sandwich with additive-free Kyoto ice cream.

kyoto_kisaki_yudofu.hours_raw: 11:00–19:15 (L.O. food 18:00, drinks 18:45); closed Wednesday; in February and on weekdays from June to September it may close at 16:00 when there are no reservations (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし — the English translation is wrong). Cards, IC cards, e-money, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 82 seats in tatami rooms and an annex with tables; private rooms (Tabelog). Smart-casual dress requested (Tabelog). English, Traditional Chinese and Korean menus; English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Free parking for 5 cars (Tabelog). Two minutes on foot from the Minamida-cho bus stop, 6 min from the Jodoji stop (Tabelog).
kyoto_kisaki_yudofu.notes: [Yudofu · near Honen-in and the Philosopher’s Path, about 50 years] A long-established tofu restaurant in a quiet Japanese house with tatami rooms and a stone-garden view: smooth yudofu in the house dashi, rich goma-dofu and yuba tempura in sets from ¥2,618. English menu and staff; free parking; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T7810562887990 is registered to the individual 折田 真人 (NTA register). The shop’s Tabelog text says it has been open about 50 years and that its yudofu dashi is unchanged since it was founded; an August 2026 guest returned after 40 years and found the tofu unchanged.
chef_bio.philosophy: The yudofu dashi has not changed since the founding (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 group of seven came down from Daimonji on a near-30-degree day and recovered over yudofu.
A May 2026 visitor was given a window seat cleared specially for the view.

kyoto_la_part_dieu.gf_detail: Ask. Vegetable-led French courses — potages, the “flower crown” vegetable starter, fish and meat mains with several sauces, bread on the side; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_la_part_dieu.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the courses are rich in vegetables (the flower crown uses dozens of kinds, May 2024), but the mains are fish or meat and nothing is described as vegan.
kyoto_la_part_dieu.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–20:30; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 10 seats (Tabelog). kyoto_la_part_dieu.notes: [French · Tanaka near Mototanaka, the vegetable flower crown] A ten-seat French restaurant with a green wall and a dark, calm room, cooked and served by one person: seasonal courses built around vegetables — the signature “flower crown” starter, rich potages, fish and meat with several sauces — from about ¥5,940 at dinner. Cash only; BYO allowed; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers say the restaurant is run by one person, who cooks and serves with good timing (March, May and December 2025), and who chooses the tea served at the end (December 2023).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 student plans to bring family here before graduating.
Two university friends reunited after 18 years over a Saturday lunch here (May 2025).

kyoto_sakesora.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai small plates, kara-age, onigiri and pasta alongside beer (2026 reviews); kara-age and pasta contain wheat; no gluten information.
kyoto_sakesora.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based obanzai, grilled mackerel, octopus, kara-age (2026 reviews).

The official site also advertises breakfast and lunch from 11:00 and, from June, no fixed closing day — check before a weekday lunch. Reservations accepted; lunch sets are limited to 15 a day and sell out, so book (Tabelog; March and May 2026). Appetizer ¥300 after 17:00 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「17:00以降つきだし300円」). Listed opening date 1 February 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sakesora.notes: [Craft beer and sake bar · Kyoto Stn, Kyoto drinks with obanzai] A small counter bar a few minutes from Kyoto Station pouring Kyoto craft beers and a wide range of Kyoto sake in tasting flights, with colourful obanzai lunches and evening small plates. Weekend daytime opening; lunch sets are limited, so book. ¥300 appetizer after 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and the official site: a café and dining bar devoted to Kyoto craft beer and sake, with obanzai and set lunches. A September 2026 review describes a young, casually dressed team of three.
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto beer and sake with Japanese food — the site says craft beer suits washoku as well as fish and chips.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto craft beer and sake tasting sets; obanzai.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor came in out of the rain, had the staff suggest sakes to taste one after another, and came back the next night for the hojicha beer.
A March 2026 weekend lunch booked just after 13:00 found the popular lunch set already sold out.
An October 2026 pair took the beer and sake tasting courses on a busy Saturday and praised the timing and the explanation of each dish.

kyoto_chishakuin_saryo_kikyo.gf_detail: Ask. Set meals include tempura and fried dishes, soy-seasoned simmered dishes and udon or soba (official menu); no gluten information.
kyoto_chishakuin_saryo_kikyo.vegan_detail: The Shojin Gozen is marked vegetarian and vegan, made with plant ingredients and a kombu and shiitake dashi (official site, Japanese text: 「植物性食材と昆布・椎茸の出汁で仕立てた、ベジタリアン・ヴィーガン対応の精進御膳」). Other sets, such as the dashimaki and tempura sets, are not marked vegan. Reviews also describe a limited shojin afternoon tea (July 2026).
kyoto_chishakuin_saryo_kikyo.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–20:00: café 10:00–20:00, lunch 11:00–14:30, dinner 17:00–20:00 (last order 19:30) (Tabelog). Breakfast is served to guests of the temple lodge (May 2026). Reservations accepted; call for 10 or more (Tabelog). Occasional temporary closures are posted on the official site. Cards incl. UnionPay; e-money; QR incl. PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 36 seats incl. a round counter (Tabelog; February 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Ground floor of Chishakuin Kaikan, the temple lodge of Chishakuin; 10 min from Keihan Shichijo, 5 min from the Higashiyama Shichijo bus stop (Tabelog).
kyoto_chishakuin_saryo_kikyo.notes: [Shojin and Kyoto set meals · Higashiyama Shichijo, inside Chishakuin temple] The restaurant and café of the Chishakuin temple lodge, near Sanjusangendo, with a round counter and garden views. The Shojin Gozen is plant-based with a kombu and shiitake dashi and marked vegan by the restaurant; dashimaki, yuba and tempura sets too, plus a limited shojin afternoon tea. Open daily 10:00–20:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the tearoom (saryo) of Chishakuin, the head temple of the Shingon Chisan school, serving the temple's shojin cuisine and Kyoto dishes, on the ground floor of Chishakuin Kaikan. Operated by 株式会社ハトヤ瑞鳳閣 (official company page). Reviews in 2026 describe the lodge renovated to hotel standard.
chef_bio.philosophy: Shojin cuisine as practised at the temple: no meat or fish, seasonal plant ingredients (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Shojin Gozen with Negoro-jiru soup; dashimaki and yuba sets.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 regular of Chishakuin chose the dashimaki set over the shojin set and noted the tearoom had been remade, smaller, with a round counter suited to solo diners.
A July 2026 visitor had the newly launched shojin afternoon tea, limited to 10 a day, and could not finish it.
An August 2026 diner was surprised that the clear soup used a shiitake dashi, and missed meat and fish.

cultural_comfort.note: Temple setting but a café-style room with a round counter; the vegan shojin set is named on the menu; Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted. No English evidence found.

kyoto_yakitori_onoji.notes: [Yakitori · Marutamachi, salt-grilled skewers over binchotan] A 15-seat counter on Marutamachi where an owner with over ten years in yakitori grills local jidori, rare cuts and seasonal vegetables over Tosa binchotan, mostly with salt; finish with the grilled rice ball with fermented butter. Rare cuts sell out — book and come early. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the owner has over ten years of yakitori experience. A July 2025 review says the owner trained at a well-known yakitori restaurant and that the shop had been open for about two years.
chef_bio.specialty: Salt-grilled jidori and rare cuts over Tosa binchotan.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 student phoned at 19:30 after a part-time shift, got one of the last counter seats, and named the grilled rice ball with fermented butter as the dish to end on.
A December 2025 regular on a sixth visit always finishes with the yakitori rice bowl.
A June 2025 diner liked the salt skewers but not the tare, and wished sold-out items were flagged when ordering.

kyoto_chez_kikusui.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-or-fish French lunch course with cream soups (2022–26 reviews).
kyoto_chez_kikusui.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:30, closed irregularly (Tabelog); dinner course by reservation only, from ¥3,500 (Tabelog remarks). kyoto_chez_kikusui.notes: [French · Kojinguchi, a one-chef lunch bistro] A long-running French bistro on Kawaramachi where one cheerful chef cooks, serves and clears alone: salad or terrine, soup, sea bream or beef, and homemade breads brought round again and again, from about ¥2,000. Cash only; a line can form at 11:30. Dinner by reservation only.

roles: Chef-owner (unnamed), cooking and serving alone (2022–25 reviews)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a French restaurant serving seasonal ingredients and homemade natural-yeast bread. Reviews from 2022 to 2025 describe one chef running the room alone; a February 2020 review noted it had reopened after a break.
chef_bio.philosophy: Credits the quality of the ingredients for the taste (June 2024 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Set French lunch with homemade breads.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor found a line before opening; at 11:30 the chef came out to check reservations, then ran the whole room alone.
A June 2024 regular marvelled at how one person kept every table in order without ever seeming rushed.
A February 2025 diner kept reaching for a rare sansho bread despite being full.

kyoto_bikashu_mahal_imadegawa.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and a bean-and-spinach curry appears (October 2025), but the sets come with chicken soup and dairy is not described (2025–2026 reviews).

kyoto_bikashu_mahal_imadegawa.notes: [Indian and Nepalese · Nishijin, cheese-naan lunch] A big, cheerful Indian-Nepalese restaurant on Imadegawa near Omiya, open every day 11:00–22:00: ¥790 daily curry lunches with a huge naan, a much-loved cheese-naan set, biryani and Nepalese thukpa. Staff greet everyone with a warm “Namaste!”.

kyoto_enmachi_reverb.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable curry is on the menu (July and September 2026), but its base and any dairy are not described.
kyoto_enmachi_reverb.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–14:45 (L.O. 14:45) and 18:00–20:00 (L.O. 20:00); closed Monday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). Order and pay first; self-service water (2026 reviews). Run by one person, so service can be slow at busy times — a note at the ordering point says so (September 2025, February and May 2026). 12 seats: 6 at the counter and three tables for two (Tabelog). On the south side of JR Enmachi Station, about 150 m away (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 14 February 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_enmachi_reverb.notes: [Curry · Enmachi Station, tandoor-grilled toppings] A small curry counter by JR Enmachi Station where one person grills chicken and seafood over charcoal in a tandoor to top smooth, coconut-and-tomato curries — tandoori seafood or lamb keema for ¥950. Order and pay first; cash only; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a shop run by one person (September 2025; February and May 2026). A sign at the entrance explains the name — “reverb”, the aftertaste — and the charcoal tandoor (February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: A lingering aftertaste — “reverb” — and charcoal-grilled tandoor meat and fish (sign at the entrance, February 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Tandoori seafood curry; tandoori chicken curry.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 regular plans visits for days with time to wait, since one person does everything.
A September 2026 visitor, back after about eight years, arrived before the 11:30 opening and waited ten minutes.

kyoto_taqueria_pachanga.gf_detail: Ask. Tacos on corn tortillas (July 2020), taco rice and guacamole; the fillings and sauces are not described for gluten (reviews).
kyoto_taqueria_pachanga.vegan_detail: Ask. Guacamole and a choice of taco fillings, but most described fillings are meat — Brazilian sausage, spicy chicken, chicken frijoles — and the taco rice has cheese (reviews).
kyoto_taqueria_pachanga.hours_raw: 12:00–22:00 (lunch 12:00–14:00); closed Tuesday, open on holidays; hours may change (Tabelog). Occasional live performances, when the shop is closed to other guests (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 14 seats (Tabelog). Takeaway of tacos, guacamole and taco rice only (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). On the corner by Eizan Mototanaka Station, about 50 m away (Tabelog).
kyoto_taqueria_pachanga.notes: [Tacos · Mototanaka Station, a laid-back corner taqueria] A tiny, easygoing taco shop on the corner by Eizan Mototanaka Station, with records and paperbacks: ¥350 tacos with a choice of fillings, taco rice, guacamole, Corona and mojitos, open all afternoon into the evening. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a long-running taco shop by Mototanaka Station (December 2023), with books and a record player that suit a slow afternoon (October 2025).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 cyclist ended a Kyoto bike tour here, after finding it closed on an earlier try.
An October 2025 regular recommends bringing a paperback rather than a phone — taco rice and a mojito on a hot afternoon.

kyoto_novecchio_enmachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a pizza-and-pasta restaurant — stone-oven pizza, pasta and bread with every course (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_novecchio_enmachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Salads and vegetable dishes appear, but the pizzas, pastas and gratins described use cheese, cream, egg, meat or seafood (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_novecchio_enmachi.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:00) and 18:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, including online (Tabelog). No service charge and no cover charge (Tabelog, original サービス料なし・チャージ料なし). At dinner, at least one drink per person (February 2026). Cards (Visa, Master, Diners) and e-money (Tabelog). 40 seats, with a semi-private space for up to 10 at the back (Tabelog). On the second floor, above a bicycle park, a minute east of the JR Enmachi Station gate along the south road (Tabelog; 2021 and May 2026).
kyoto_novecchio_enmachi.notes: [Italian · Enmachi Station, stone-oven pizza] A bright, high-ceilinged Italian on a second floor a minute from JR Enmachi Station: chewy stone-oven pizzas, pastas and good-value lunches from ¥1,200 to a ¥3,000 seven-part course, with craft beer at night. No service or cover charge; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text explains the name as a blend of the Italian “novità” (newness, creativity) and “vecchio” (old, well aged, like wine). Tabelog’s name search lists a second shop, at Saiin.
chef_bio.philosophy: Something new and something well aged (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 group of four classmates around fifty ordered more pizza and pasta after the first round.
An October 2026 party of five liked that staff took orders in person instead of by QR code.

kyoto_taco_to_kentaro.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki batter is wheat (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_taco_to_kentaro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus in every takoyaki; octopus rice, salad and soup (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_taco_to_kentaro.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00; irregular closures (Tabelog). Bookings taken; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). No cards or e-money (Tabelog). 10 counter seats; smoking allowed; takeaway (Tabelog). 8 min from the Kumano-jinja-mae bus stop, 16 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn; coin parking a minute away (Tabelog; January 2024 and May 2026 reviews).
kyoto_taco_to_kentaro.notes: [Takoyaki bar · Shogoin] A small octopus-themed counter where the owner makes big takoyaki to order in dozens of oddly named flavours — Kujo green onion, potato, mentaiko and lotus root — with octopus salad, rice and soup, and beer or sake. About ¥1,000–2,000. No cards; smoking allowed.

roles: Owner (given name, per reviews and the shop name)
chef_bio.background: Opened 17 September 2010 (Tabelog). A May 2026 regular had visited the earlier shop on Niomon-dori, event stalls and a second shop at Demachiyanagi before this Yoshida location. The shop runs a recurring music event, "Octopus Night" (vol. 6 on 10 January 2026, Kyoto City tourism site).
chef_bio.philosophy: A passionate octopus lover's menu of original takoyaki (March 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 regular of the old Niomon-dori shop sat at the counter with chilled tofu and two bottles of beer, watching eight Kujo green-onion takoyaki being made.
A May 2026 goshuin pilgrim stopped for lunch and had takoyaki, octopus rice, octopus salad and octopus soup.
In March 2025 a returning visitor started with the octopus salad, then tacos takoyaki and mentaiko-and-lotus-root takoyaki.

kyoto_hazuki_korean_higashikujo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: seafood pancakes, japchae and bibim noodles; soy and gochujang seasonings (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_hazuki_korean_higashikujo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork belly, seafood and meat-broth stews (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_hazuki_korean_higashikujo.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). About 20 seats at tables, with a raised tatami area and a counter used by solo diners; smoking allowed (Tabelog; July 2025, April and July 2026 reviews). Recently renovated (July 2025 review). 100 m south of Hachijo-Kawaramachi on the west side; about 10 min from Kyoto Stn Hachijo exit (Tabelog).
kyoto_hazuki_korean_higashikujo.notes: [Korean home cooking · Higashikujo] A bright, recently renovated Korean spot south of Kyoto Station known for big portions: thick samgyeopsal sets wrapped in perilla, seafood jeon, tteokbokki and stews, and an all-you-can-eat-and-drink samgyeopsal plan at ¥4,500. Cards not taken (QR yes); closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Not stated on Tabelog. A July 2025 regular returning after a long gap found it renovated.

anecdotes.text: After visiting the new teamLab in Kyoto in October 2025, two friends had the ¥1,800 samgyeopsal set; the staff brought new chopsticks with a smile each of the three times one dropped them.
A September 2025 diner compared the seafood jeon and tteokbokki to food eaten in Seoul.
A pair of July 2026 diners sheltering from rain could not finish a shared stone-grilled bibimbap, bibim noodles and miso chige.

kyoto_sushi_masa_miyakomichi.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi and sashimi with soy sauce; lunch sets include tempura and fried oysters (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_masa_miyakomichi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and seafood restaurant (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_masa_miyakomichi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:30), following the hours of Kintetsu Meitengai Miyakomichi (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 counter seats per Tabelog; an undated job listing for the operator, 株式会社AYT, says 32 seats; reviewers describe a sushi counter, tables and a sunken kotatsu table (January 2025). Non-smoking; children welcome; photo menu; takeaway; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Inside Kintetsu Meitengai Miyakomichi at the Hachijo side of Kyoto Station, about 1 min from the gates (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_masa_miyakomichi.notes: [Sushi & seasonal fish · Kyoto Station] A sushi counter in the Miyakomichi arcade, right by the Hachijo gates: quick lunch sets and seafood bowls for about ¥1,200–2,500 before a train, and seasonal dinners — returning bonito, big oysters, matsutake dobin-mushi — with sake for about ¥8,000–15,000. Open daily.

roles: Chefs (unnamed); run by 株式会社AYT (job listing)
chef_bio.background: Run by 株式会社AYT, per a public job listing that gives the shop as 「株式会社 AYT すし昌」 in Miyakomichi. Tabelog's shop text describes seasonal seafood from skilled chefs and an omakase course.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal seafood and chef's-choice sushi right at Kyoto Station (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: With little time before a Shinkansen in March 2026, a returning diner asked for something quick and got a thick-cut seafood bowl that beat expectations.
An October 2026 party celebrated a mentor's retirement over seasonal dishes, matsutake dobin-mushi and sake, finishing with nigiri.
A January 2025 lunch diner found the recommended set ordinary and the staff's teamwork in need of work, though the red miso soup was good.

kyoto_schole_umekoji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat pizza crusts, onion rings and fried chicken (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_schole_umekoji.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and custom pizzas, but most dishes have cheese or meat (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_schole_umekoji.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–21:00 (last order 20:30); no regular holiday (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB), iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 19 seats (counter 3, tables 16); non-smoking; English menu; kids' menu; strollers welcome; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). 1 min from the Shichijo-Omiya/Kyoto Aquarium bus stop, 8 min from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_schole_umekoji.notes: [Custom-pizza diner · Kyoto Aquarium] A bright American-style diner a minute from the Kyoto Aquarium bus stop: build-your-own pizzas, Margherita from about ¥1,000, BBQ beef, buffalo wings and onion rings, and half-pizza lunch sets. English and kids' menus; family-friendly. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 January 2023 (Tabelog). An October 2025 reviewer lists sister restaurants — Apitt Burger (Arashiyama, Minami-Kusatsu, Kinugasa), Craft Dining Apitt (Sanjo) and Rice Overalls (Seika) — and says the shop supports urban sports such as BMX and breaking, with many staff experienced in double dutch, shown on the in-shop screens. The name is Greek for "leisure" (same review).

anecdotes.text: A family of four in December 2025 made a custom pizza with Kujo green onion and shirasu on the son's suggestion; the parents liked it best.
An August 2025 organiser booked a 2–4 p.m. private lunch for about 15 before a match, on the ¥4,000 party course.
A March 2026 diner was charmed to get ginger ale in the old green Canada Dry bottle with a chilled glass.

kyoto_curry_nandi_ichijoji.gf_detail: Ask: spice curries with rice and papad (papad is usually lentil), but roux and fried toppings are not described for wheat (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_curry_nandi_ichijoji.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists vegetarian options; lentil-and-vegetable and chickpea curries, and a mixed-vegetable black curry, are on the menu, but butter and ghee are not ruled out (2020–2023 reviews).
kyoto_curry_nandi_ichijoji.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–16:30 and 18:00–22:00; closed Thursday. No reservations. 10 seats, mostly counter — curries are cooked one by one, so expect a short wait (August 2022). Non-smoking. Children welcome but no children's curry (Tabelog). Take-away. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Prices raised 1 July 2024 (Tabelog). Behind 天下一品 総本店 in Ichijoji; a car park next door (January 2025). Opened 24 July 2014 (Tabelog).
kyoto_curry_nandi_ichijoji.notes: [Spice curry · Ichijoji, a couple's ten-seat counter] A tiny counter behind Tenkaippin's main shop where a couple cook each curry to order: a two-curry plate pairing the fierce black curry with keema, lentils or mild chickpeas, with papad and salad, at the same price as a single. Expect a wait and real heat. Cash only; closed Thursday.

roles: Run by a couple, not named (April 2023 review)
chef_bio.background: Opened 24 July 2014 (Tabelog). Reviewers from 2017 to 2026 describe a snack-bar-like counter with an Indian-style interior, a couple who recommend the double curry, curries cooked fresh after ordering, and a salad from the owner while you wait.

anecdotes.text: April 2023: "The couple running the restaurant recommended trying the double curry… the extremely spicy black curry was the hottest I've ever tasted."
January 2025: "While you can adjust the spice level upon request, I won't say anything because it's already quite spicy here."
April 2026: "I appreciated that both the single and combination curry were priced the same."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 三代目カレー舎、NANDI。、カレー、左京区一乗寺築田町95 第2メゾン白川 1F、叡電茶山駅・一乗寺駅から徒歩10分、11:30〜16:30・18:00〜22:00、木曜休み、予約不可、10席、禁煙、子供可 (子供用のカレーはなし)、持ち帰り可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、野菜にこだわり・ベジタリアン対応、2024年7月1日から値上げ、2014年7月24日オープン。口コミ (2017年8月〜2026年4月、英語): 天下一品総本店の裏、夫婦で営む、カウンター中心、注文ごとに調理、2種を選ぶダブルカレー (激辛の黒カレー (チキン・ポーク・ラム・ミックス野菜)、キーマ、レンズ豆と野菜、ひよこ豆、日替わりのバターチキンやバターシュリンプ)、パパドとサラダ付き、1,000円 (2022年)・1,100円 (2023年)、シングルとダブルが同じ値段、パクチー、ラッシー、辛さの調整可、隣に駐車場。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; very spicy by default; cash only.

kyoto_manyoken_style_takashimaya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: bread, potage, crab cream croquettes, breaded pork cutlet and sauces (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_manyoken_style_takashimaya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef, fish and croquette mains; consommé (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_manyoken_style_takashimaya.hours_raw: Tabelog: weekdays 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; weekends and holidays 11:00–16:00 and 17:00–22:00 (last order 20:40); closing days follow Takashimaya Kyoto. Reservations taken; often a table without one on weekdays (2026 reviews). 86 seats; a private room for 8. No smoking until 17:00, smoking seats after (Tabelog). Strollers manageable — wide spacing (August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR. Take-away. Takashimaya Kyoto 7F, connected to Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn.
kyoto_manyoken_style_takashimaya.notes: [French · Takashimaya Kyoto 7F, the old house's casual branch] The department-store branch of 萬養軒, which reviewers date to 1904: lunch sets of potage, salad and a crab-croquette or beef-cheek main for about ¥2,400, and good-value courses with steak or sea bream, in a quiet, roomy dining room. One diner found the courses came too fast (November 2025); another thought the pork cutlet just okay (August 2026). Smoking seats after 17:00.

roles: Not named in a source; branch of ぎをん 萬養軒 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the group is ぎをん 萬養軒 (the French restaurant on Hanamikoji, opposite the Gion Kaburenjo; lunch ¥7,000 and ¥9,000, dinner ¥15,000 and ¥19,000 from April 2025) and this MANYOKEN style shop in Takashimaya Kyoto, and it takes 萬養軒 to department-store Kyoto fairs. Two September 2026 reviewers say 萬養軒 was founded in 1904 as Kyoto's first French restaurant, formerly on Shijo-dori, and one recalls Princess Diana dining there and the writer Shotaro Ikenami as a regular.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets; crab cream croquettes; beef-cheek stew.

anecdotes.text: November 2025: "It felt like the dishes were coming out so quickly that I finished my meal in no time… Next time, I will make sure to request a slower pace."
September 2026: "When I was younger, I admired Manyoken on Shijo Street and visited it alone, nervously trying the consommé."
August 2026: the breaded pork cutlet "was delicious, but I felt it was just okay."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ぎをん 萬養軒、フランス料理、本店は東山区祇園町南側570-120 2F (花見小路四条下ル、祇園歌舞練場前、火・水定休)、MANYOKEN style 京都 高島屋店 (定休日は百貨店と同じ)、2025年4月からランチ7,000円・9,000円、ディナー15,000円・19,000円 (税・サービス料込、本店)、京都展の催事に出店。食べログ: MANYOKEN style 京都高島屋店、フレンチ、下京区四条通河原町西入ル真町52 京都タカシマヤ 7F、平日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜22:00、土日祝 11:00〜16:00・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 20:40)、休みは高島屋に準じる、予約可、86席、個室 (8名)、17時まで禁煙・以降は喫煙席あり、カード・電子マネー・QR可、持ち帰り可。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): サラダ・ポタージュ・パンかご飯とメインのランチ (ズワイガニのクリームコロッケ、牛ほほ肉、豚のカツレツ) 2,420円、おすすめコース4,950円 (コンソメのジュレ、前菜、ロースのステーキか鯛のポワレ、デザート)、ローズコース、玉ねぎのスプマンテ、1904年創業の京都初のフランス料理店という声、ダイアナ妃や池波正太郎の話、料理が出るのが早すぎたという声、カツレツはまあまあという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Department-store restaurant floor; reservations taken.

existence.note: Official site lists the shop; Tabelog reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_murakamiju_honten.gf_detail: Ask: senmaizuke is turnip, kombu and salt per Takashimaya's description, but other pickles may use soy sauce; check labels (Takashimaya; reviews).
kyoto_murakamiju_honten.vegan_detail: Ask: vegetable pickles (senmaizuke, shibazuke, Mibuna, takuan) are plant-based in principle, but seasonings such as bonito extract are not described; check labels (reviews).
kyoto_murakamiju_honten.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 9:00–18:00; closed 1–3 January. A pickle shop with no eating or drinking space — take-away and shipping only (Tabelog; January 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX), transit IC, QUICPay, QR. Senmaizuke is seasonal (winter; sold out by early March 2026). In a lane behind Edion, south-east of the Shijo-Kawaramachi crossing, by the Takase river (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_murakamiju_honten.notes: [Kyoto pickles · Shijo-Kawaramachi, an 1832 pickle house] The main shop of a pickle maker dating from 1832, in a lane by the Takase river just off Shijo-Kawaramachi: winter senmaizuke heavy with kombu, shibazuke all year, and shop-only sansho mushrooms and young ginger that keep only days. A shop, not a restaurant — no eating space. Open daily 9:00–18:00.

chef_bio.background: Takashimaya's food column describes 村上重本店 as a pickle maker founded in Tenpo 3 (1832) in Sendo-cho, Shimogyo-ku, making pickles that bring out the vegetables' own taste, with senmaizuke of Shogoin turnip and shibazuke its best-known items; Takashimaya stocks it in eight stores. Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe a handsome old shopfront, tasting samples, and items sold only at the main shop.

anecdotes.text: December 2025: senmaizuke "packed with thick slices of kombu kelp… Once you get used to this flavor, you won't be able to go back to sweet senmai."
March 2026: in early March "I found a notice in the store saying that the season had ended" for senmaizuke.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 村上重本店、その他、下京区西木屋町四条下る船頭町190、四条河原町の南東、毎日 9:00〜18:00、1月1日〜3日休み、予約不可、漬物店で飲食スペースなし、持ち帰り、カード (JCB・AMEX)・交通系IC・QUICPay・QR可。高島屋のコラム: 1832 (天保三) 年創業、下京区船頭町、野菜本来の味をいかす漬物、聖護院かぶと昆布と塩の千枚漬、通年のいちばん人気はしば漬、高島屋の8店で取り扱い。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年6月、英語): 甘くない昆布たっぷりの千枚漬 (冬季、3月初めに終了)、しば漬、つぼ漬たくあん、壬生菜、柚子大根、菜の花、Kyo Takase、からし漬、本店限定のきのこの山椒煮と姫しょうが、試食、エディオンの裏の路地。

cultural_comfort.note: Shop only — no eating space; tasting samples.

kyoto_osake_to_gohan_to_taka.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, fried pork, spring rolls, keema curry, soy-based dishes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_osake_to_gohan_to_taka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led izakaya — sashimi, cured mackerel, dashi tofu (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_osake_to_gohan_to_taka.hours_raw: Tabelog: 16:00–23:00; closed Tuesday. Book on weekends (April 2025). Appetiser charge ¥1,000 — Tabelog, Japanese original 「お通し代1,000円」 (reviewers paid ¥700–800 in 2024–2025). 12 seats: an 8-seat counter at the open kitchen and one table for 4. Non-smoking. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money. In the Marunaka Building on Ura-dera-machi, behind OPA, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn. Opened June 2024 (July 2024 review).
kyoto_osake_to_gohan_to_taka.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Kawaramachi, a 2024 counter of fish and Kyoto vegetables] A clean, wood-scented 12-seat counter on Ura-dera-machi opened in 2024 by a cook with two decades in Kyoto kitchens: cured mackerel with gari, toro-taku spring rolls, hamo tempura, seasonal vegetables and a keema curry to finish, with a good sake list. One diner balked at the ¥700 otoshi (March 2025); Tabelog now lists ¥1,000. Open from 16:00; closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner-cook, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Per a July 2024 reviewer, the owner went independent in June 2024 after about 20 years in restaurants; a September 2024 reviewer says the owner seems to have come from "Manzara-tei". Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a calm, clean room with an open kitchen, an owner who comes out to chat, and what looked to one diner like a couple running it (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Cured mackerel with gari; toro-taku spring rolls.

anecdotes.text: March 2025: "Otoshi... JPY 700, huh? Hmm."
April 2025: on a Saturday night "every place I called was fully booked and turned me away… I found out that Taka had an opening."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お酒とごはんと たか、居酒屋・海鮮、中京区四条裏寺通上ル中之町576 丸仲ビル 1F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、16:00〜23:00、火曜休み、原文で「お通し代1,000円」、12席 (オープンキッチンのカウンター8席、4名のテーブル1卓)、禁煙、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可。口コミ (2024年7月〜2026年8月、英語): 2024年6月オープン、約20年飲食店で働いた店主が独立、Manzara-tei 出身らしいという声、木の香り、季節の前菜の盛り合わせ (700〜800円)、ガリしめ鯖750円、メカジキの刺身1,050円、だし豆腐700円、昆布締めの鯛、鰹と春菊と文旦、トロたく生春巻、鱧ととうもろこしの天ぷら、水なす、豚の唐揚げ、琵琶湖の鮎、ポテトサラダ、だし巻、締めのキーマカレー、日本酒 (Kaishun など)、芋焼酎だいやめ、夫婦で営んでいるようだという声、お通し700円は高いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter izakaya; ¥1,000 otoshi.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_yakiniku_renzou_sakaimachi.gf_detail: Not GF: yakiniku with soy-based sauces, cold noodles, bibimbap and set meals (2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_renzou_sakaimachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku restaurant (2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_renzou_sakaimachi.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); irregular closing days (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; booked stays have a time limit, but guests may stay until the next booking arrives (Tabelog). One October 2026 visitor could not book a course on the day and booked a table instead. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 84 seats over two floors, with counter, tables, sofas and private rooms; 1F non-smoking, 2F heated tobacco only; the floors can be booked separately (Tabelog). Coin parking nearby (October 2026). 5 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_renzou_sakaimachi.notes: [Yakiniku · Sakaimachi-Sanjo, wagyu in a quiet Japanese house] A calm, screened yakiniku house serving tender wagyu tongue, harami and loin, a ¥2,200 lunch set and courses up to the photogenic staircase platter, with birthday plates on request. Some found side dishes and finishers weaker than the meat; one October 2026 guest was promised a dessert for posting a review that never came. Open till 23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yakiniku restaurant opened 15 December 2023 on two floors near Sakaimachi-Sanjo. Gurunavi lists a second Renzou shop in Shimamoto, Osaka Prefecture. Reviewers in 2026 describe attentive staff who explain the cuts, and screens that keep tables private.
chef_bio.specialty: Kyo no Kaidan Mori staircase platter; salted tongue.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner who doubted the staircase platter found it ordered from light tongue up to richer cuts, with not one tough piece.
An October 2026 visitor was told a review would earn a dessert; after showing the review and waiting 15 minutes the dessert never came, and an unordered soup arrived at the bill.
A September 2026 solo birthday diner loved the meat but found the bibimbap, oxtail soup and dessert platter disappointing.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・居酒屋・日本料理、中京区大阪材木町690、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、不定休、予約可 (時間制だが次の予約まではゆっくりできる)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、84席、個室あり、1階禁煙・2階は加熱式たばこのみ、1階と2階は別々に貸切可、2023年12月15日開店。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): 落ち着いた和の内装、ついたて、昼の焼肉3種盛り定食2,200円、5種盛り、京の日本庭園コース4,500円、6,500円のコース、京の階段盛り7,980円、塩タン、和牛上ロース、ハラミ、シャトーブリアン、タン刺し、ユッケ、ナムル、冷麺、テールスープ、肉寿司、誕生日のプレート、店員が忙しそうとの声、口コミを書くとデザートと言われたが来なかったとの声 (2026年10月)、ビビンバやテールスープは物足りないとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain the cuts; private rooms; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.
